verdicts.reason: A puts the legal fine print first at the far left as an unreadable 4-line wrapped block, so it reads before the headline. Its tiny can floats alone in the middle, leaving a big dead gap before the CTA, and 'WEEKEND ONLY' is moved below the body copy. B reads in a sensible order (can, headline, copy, CTA) with clean left-aligned text, but the legal line is microscopic and low-contrast, 'WEEKEND ONLY' is demoted to the bottom, and there is a wide empty band between the text and the CTA.
